scope: Complete the common FT4 gate with a later owned demand that is formed after accepted capability certification, autonomously chooses and pays for an applicable retained route, consumes its actual native output and settles. Compare an exact matched certificate-revocation counterfactual, preserve unavailable support and unreachable demands, and include the accepted declared paid opposition controller in the final common gate. The caller supplies no request, route, certificate key, successful candidate, answer or success flag.
rules: The controller is constructed only from one accepted certified AutonomousCapabilityController and its exact paired native engine. Its actor, certificate and prior demand are discovered from that controller; no caller-selected certificate or route is accepted.

The later demand must be admitted after certification from a current paid owned unresolved native need. Request formation remains the accepted IntegratedDemandController path and route choice remains the accepted IntegratedRoutePolicy priority over owned evidence.

Only the bound certificate key is offered to route choice. Applicability is recomputed from the bound RetentionLedger and the actual later Demand. A retained selection must cite that applicable certificate, preserve the origin seat and dimensionality, complete paid native selection and movement, feed the exact movement output to a paid same-scope consumer and settle the exact admitted demand.

The matched evidence-removal control begins from the same native checkpoint, capability checkpoint, later need and policy. Explicit revocation of the bound certificate is the sole pre-choice difference. It must remove retained eligibility and retained selection without erasing permanent closure history or changing TIM, seat dimensionality or native resource defaults.

Unavailable, foreign, non-consenting or unallowed support remains explicitly in the option inventory with an ineligibility reason and cannot fabricate traversal or fulfillment. Harder or otherwise inapplicable demands remain pending or defer according to the accepted route policy.
Conflicting later demands are admitted and ordered from owned evidence by the accepted age-and-identity rules. The evaluator supplies neither a goal sequence nor the successful demand.

The final common gate executes the already accepted opposition controller in both settings with its declared consecutive cp then n moves, exact cp orientation payment and exact native payments. FT4.3b2b does not replace that controller or infer opposition from labels.
Checkpoint restoration is paired to the exact native engine and exact capability checkpoint and preserves demand, route, consumer, settlement and retention event sequences byte-for-byte.

An independent auditor imports no autonomous-reuse controller. It invokes accepted capability, fulfillment, route-policy and opposition auditors, reconstructs the later request, applicable certificate, selected route, native payments, exact output consumption and settlement from raw committed records, and rejects forged certificate, choice, payment, scope, output or outcome links.

TIM, seat dimensionality, native resource defaults, accepted subordinate policies and inherited source remain unchanged. Retained capability remains guarded content participation and never becomes material competence.

Acceptance requires the twelve exact new methods plus all one hundred eighteen exact FT4.1-FT4.3b2a predecessor methods, both-setting retained-reuse and opposition witnesses, the matched revocation control, a strict source freeze and unchanged source.
Passing accepts the bounded FT4 engineering gate only. It does not validate psychology, close theoretical C/D registers, elect later reserve or conditioning hypotheses, or complete FT5-FT9.
gate: One hundred thirty exact methods pass with zero failures/errors; canonical and workflow witnesses each form a later owned demand after certification, autonomously select retained from actual applicable evidence, pay and settle exact native work; matched revocation removes that effect; unavailable support, deferral, conflict and paid opposition controls pass; independent reconstruction matches the registered freeze and source remains unchanged.
